sentence: This project builds a system that uses light and bacteria to turn carbon dioxide into biofuels.
This project builds ways to control quantum networks so that they can share entanglement despite noisy hardware.
This project studies how drought and warming change biodiversity and how well grassland ecosystems work.
This project uses laser powder-bed fusion to make alloys from pure element powders and ceramic particles, then tests their microstructure and mechanical properties.
This project builds wearable devices with artificial intelligence that track facial expressions and hand gestures to help people learn sign language.
This project builds algorithms for quantum computers that choose how to index large databases, and compares them with classical algorithms.
This project builds machine learning methods that link different kinds of data from brain cells to predict what the cells do.
This project builds tools that let biologists study viruses that infect microbes, using sequencing data.
This project builds ways to find knowledge organized in graphs and give it to generative artificial intelligence systems so they solve problems better.
This project designs nanoparticle carriers that hold nitrogen fertilizer and are sprayed onto plant leaves to deliver nitrogen into the plant.
This project builds a technology that reproduces the sound of physical spaces from a small number of acoustic measurements.
This project studies how the upside-down jellyfish and the algae inside its gut cells set up a stable symbiosis.
This project studies what controls the shape of cavities that form downstream of bedrock bumps as glacier ice slides.
This project studies how nitrogen scarcity affects how bromeliads photosynthesize, grow, and cycle nitrogen through ecosystems.
This project studies Weddell seals to find out how immigrant mothers affect the way the seal population changes.
This project builds course materials on calculus, probability, and statistics for computer science that draw on programming and real-world applications.
This project builds tools for adding smart abilities, such as sensing and energy-harvesting, to passive physical interfaces like light switches.
This project builds quantum networks that link arrays of individual atoms and atom-like defects in diamond using single particles of light.
This project builds software, data sets, and artificial intelligence models to help researchers study how micromobility vehicles interact in public spaces.
